title: Apply for a Working with Children Check
summary: Find out about and apply for a Working with Children Check (WWCC), which is required for working or volunteering with children in NSW.
intro:
The Working with Children Check (WWCC) is a requirement for anyone who works or volunteers in child-related work in NSW. It involves a National Police Check (criminal history record check) and a review of reportable workplace misconduct.

Results of a National Police Check can take up to 4 weeks to be received.

The outcome of a check is either a clearance to work with children or a bar against working with children. If cleared, the check will be valid for 5 years, however applicants are continuously monitored.

The application costs $107 for paid workers and is free for volunteers.
what_you_need: One primary use in the community document
Two secondary use in the community documents
Expired documents are acceptable unless specified otherwise
If your primary use document is not a NSW Driver Licence or a NSW Photo Card, you must apply for a customer number with Transport for NSW (individuals)
The NSW Digital Driver Licence is accepted, but other digital identity documents (like a digital Medicare card) are not accepted
Four proof of identity (POI) documents are required, including at least one document that contains your signature and photo
All POI documents must be current and original

how_to_steps.text: Complete the online form ensuring the name you enter matches your identity documents exactly.
Visit a Service NSW Centre to present your original identity documents and (if applicable) pay the fee.

more_info.text: To find out when a WWCC is required, visit Who needs a WWCC.
If you'd like help with your application, contact the Office of the Children's Guardian.

faqs.q: How long is a Working with Children Check valid for?
faqs.a: If cleared, the check will be valid for 5 years, although applicants are continuously monitored.

faqs.q: How much does the Working with Children Check cost?
faqs.a: The application costs $107 for paid workers and is free for volunteers.

faqs.q: What is required to apply for a Working with Children Check?
faqs.a: You must be aged 18 or over.
